Ava (Sales): IonWorks (enterprise health) wants a POC with a custom Llama-variant. They need catalog fit, KV-cache compatibility, KMS/HSM attestation, and EU-only residency. Any immediate red flags?
Priya (SE): Do they have a nonstandard tokenizer? We need tokenizer.json + merges or tokenizer files. Also need model card, license (commercial allowed?), and whether attention uses RMSNorm or something custom.
Diego (SRE): Infra notes: 4-bit quant OK but some conversions reorder KV caching which can break continuous batching. We should run a KV layout probe after upload.
Liam (Runtime Eng): Checklist: sample checkpoint (safetensors preferred), config.json, tokenizer, sample prompts, eval set (50). Run `redwood model inspect` locally to detect attention & tokenizer: `redwood model inspect --path s3://ionworks-poc/checkpoint.safetensors --show-ops`.
Ava (Sales): I'll request a presigned S3 link and their security questionnaire. They also explicitly require HSM-backed KMS + attestation.
Priya (SE): If tokenizer is custom we can build a shim but conversion time varies. Best to get a tiny sample checkpoint (1-2 layers) so we can validate tokenizer + attention quickly.
Diego (SRE): HSM + KMS is possible but requires legal sign-off on vendor and infra setup for Redwood Private. That adds lead time.
Liam (Runtime Eng): Performance estimate: they said ~100k requests/day, avg 512 tokens. That's ~1.16 rps average, but with 5x peaks. We need QPS pattern and p95 SLO. 300ms p95 for a 30B quantized model is aggressive on hosted. Recommend Dedicated or Private for that SLO.
Ava (Sales): They confirmed 5x peak during business hours and want 300ms p95. Also EU data residency and audit logs required.
Priya (SE): Action: I'll run tokenizer + forward pass once checkpoint uploaded. If export fails, recommend re-export with HF transformers v4.31 and safetensors.
Diego (SRE): I'll run KV-cache probe within 24h of upload. I'll also attach SOC2 + architecture note once validated.
Liam (Runtime Eng): I'll prepare a perf harness for a 10k sample sweep on Dedicated after onboarding. Then I'll produce a cost calc for Dedicated steady + burst reserve.
Ava (Sales): Pricing ask: quick ballpark for Dedicated for a 30B q4 profile to compare with self-hosting.
Liam (Runtime Eng): Will produce a ballpark after perf numbers. Rough intuition: Dedicated with reserved capacity + burst will likely beat naive self-hosting for ops/availability, but exact $ depends on concurrency and KV hit rates.
Ava (Sales): Proposed plan and ETA: 1) Request presigned S3 + sec questionnaire from IonWorks (Ava), 2) Priya runs tokenization/compat check on upload, 3) Diego runs KV probe, 4) Liam runs perf/cost calc. Target: 48 hours for first round.
OpsBot: Reminder: do not post customer PII in public channels; attach sensitive artifacts to secure ticket. Onboarding checklist: https://console.redwood.ai/docs/onboarding/poc-checklist
Priya (SE): If they want faster, ask for a tiny sample checkpoint and tokenizer files.
Ava (Sales): Thanks team :thumbsup: I'll ping when presigned link + questionnaire arrive.
